name: zclass_cls_di_segment_batch_vs_polygon
description: zClass_cls_di::BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentBatchVsPolygon copies the caller's active segment mask, intersects active segment endpoints against a polygon plane, prunes projected hits against the polygon edges, and appends per-segment hit candidates with the owner node, surface normal, hit point, and scene payload.
known_limits: The smoke covers active-mask copy semantics, backface gating, two-sided face flag behavior, outside-polygon rejection, hit position, normal, owner, and scene payload. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass DI segment-batch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x486290 validates the segment endpoint ABI, local active-mask copy, zMath triangle-normal dependency, backface flag at flagsAndVertexCount bit 8, projected polygon edge pruning, candidate count cap, and appended candidate fields.
